note: Butterfield's retail schedule (January 2026): chequing carries a monthly maintenance fee of 10 dollars and a monthly compliance fee of 3, both waived for seniors and charities. Clarien's fee schedule: a personal chequing account's monthly maintenance fee is 12 dollars and its compliance fee 3; its seniors' accounts pay neither. Neither bank says at what age a customer is a senior, so the game charges the fees in full.
